title: Lava Step
description: A challenging mod where blocks beneath your feet turn into lava if you stand still for too long.
body:
# 🔥 Don't Stop Moving!
Lava Step adds a thrilling survival challenge to your world. If you hesitate for even a few seconds, the ground beneath your feet will vanish, replaced by scorching lava.

Whether you are exploring deep caves or building your base, you must stay on the move to survive. Standing still is no longer an option!

## 🛠 Key Features:
- The Molten Timer: After standing on a block for a set amount of time, it transforms into lava.
- Visual Warning: Watch for smoke particles rising from your feet—that’s your cue to run!
- Water Evaporation: Trying to hide in a puddle? Water blocks around you will evaporate into steam before the heat turns the floor into lava.
- Highly Customizable: Use in-game commands to adjust the difficulty to your liking.
## 💻 Commands:

```
/lavadelay <seconds>
```
 — Set how long you can stand on a block before it turns into lava (Default: 3 seconds). Requires operator permissions.
